summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 22, 2026 press release announcing the U.S. launch of its Structured Receivable Program, including Real-Time SRP, to point-of-sale originators of small business loans and leases. Previously all U.S. SRP fundings targeted the retail consumer sector; the expansion more than doubles the estimated U.S. market opportunity and supports a target of at least US$3 billion in additional U.S. SRP fundings next year. No securities, ownership, pricing, board recommendation, advisor or regulatory clock is involved; this is an ordinary operating business update, not a special situation. Watch execution risk and partner ramp versus the stated US$3 billion target.
